list.search: Search by number, customer or subject
list.label: Quotations
list.empty: No quotations yet. Press "New quotation" to make the first one.

editor.newSubtitle: Prices are fixed when the quotation is sent.
editor.validHint: Leave empty for the default: 15 days from the quotation date (company setting).
editor.optionalHint: Lines marked "Optional" are shown on screen but are not counted in the totals or printed.
editor.fixLines: Check the lines marked in red.
editor.badValidUntil: The validity cannot end before the quotation date.

lineErrors.not_for_sale: This item cannot be sold now (inactive, not for sale or without a price).
lineErrors.unit_decimals: This unit does not take this many decimals.
lineErrors.too_large: The discount is larger than the line.

view.title: Quotation
view.optionalNote: Optional lines are shown for information; they are not in the totals.
view.openInvoice: Open the invoice made from this quotation

actions.title: Actions
actions.sendNote: Sending fixes the prices. After that, changes need a new revision.
actions.convertNote: The invoice keeps the quotation's prices and discounts, not today's prices. Optional lines are left out.
actions.cannotRevise: The lines cannot be read yet. Wait a moment, or check that each line still fits its unit.

send.title: Send the quotation?
send.text: Quotation {number} will be marked as sent and its prices fixed. To change it later, make a new revision.

accept.title: Customer accepted?
accept.text: Quotation {number} will be marked as accepted. You can then convert it to an invoice.

reject.title: Customer rejected?
reject.text: Quotation {number} will be marked as rejected. This cannot be undone.

cancel.title: Cancel the quotation?
cancel.text: Quotation {number} will be cancelled. It is kept in the list but cannot be used again.

expire.title: Mark as expired?
expire.text: The validity of quotation {number} has ended. It will be marked as expired.

revise.title: Make a new revision?
revise.text: Revision {next} of {number} is made as a draft with the same lines, for you to change and send. This revision is kept and marked as replaced.

convert.title: Convert to an invoice?
convert.text: An invoice draft is made from quotation {number}. Check it in Invoices (A4) and issue it there.
